Pig-a-Boom.description: Pig-a-Boom by Pigaboom is an innovative crash game where players watch a flying piggy multiplier rise. Players choose their bet amount and must strategically cash out before the inevitable crash to secure their winnings and maximize payouts.
what_makes_it_unique: Pig-a-Boom introduces unique Bonus Buy features including Lock Bonus, Insurance, Wild Multipliers, Boom Bonus, Mystery Drops, and the Hero Jackpot, giving players multiple ways to enhance gameplay and chase bigger rewards.
